description: Lists Huasheng videos, newest first; with query, searches every project by title or script. has_more=true: pass next_cursor back only if the user asked for the complete list. Use it to find another video the user names or describes, instead of asking for a pid; never to guess the current video (omit pid for that). Read-only; rename with huasheng_set_style setting=name.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call; it already carries query and since_days

limit.description: How many videos to return, up to 50; default 20

query.description: Optional title or script text to search across every project

since_days.description: Only videos created in the last N days; pass only when the user asked for a time range

name: huasheng_list_projects
title: Find Huasheng videos
